zh-Hans.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 用于语聊发言，通过自建语音服务向房间成员传送声音。
zh-Hans.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: 用于从系统照片选择器读取你选中的头像照片，确认保存后上传并公开展示。
zh-Hans.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kiki 当前不使用摄像头；语音聊天不会开启相机，头像仅从你选中的相册照片上传。

en.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Let people in your room hear you when you turn on your microphone. Voice chat runs on our own servers.
en.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo for your profile. Only the photo you confirm is uploaded and shown publicly.
en.NSCameraUsageDescription: kikitalk does not use your camera. Voice chat is audio only, and profile photos come from photos you choose.
